caseName: National Ass'n for the Advancement of Colored People v. Gray
caseNameFull: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People v. Gray, Attorney General of Virginia
attorneys: Robert L. Carter on the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 365 U. S. 842, to the Supreme Court of Appeals of Virginia. Argued November 8, 1961. Restored to the calendar for reargument, 369 U. S. 833. The motion to substitute Robert Y. Button et al. in the place of Frederick T. Gray et al. as parties respondent is granted.
